# Melotech

> Melotech builds custom software for businesses: web apps, websites,
> internal tools, automation and new products, and audits the security of
> what is already running. Work is scoped to revenue gained or hours saved
> per month, and every price is published. Three practices: building
> software, improving how a team ships it, and reviewing what is live.

<!-- cms:pricing -->
Every price on the site is public. Work is quoted as days multiplied by a
day rate of 350 to 550 euro. There are fifteen fixed services plus a
retainer. A visitor can tick the services they need and read the total
without contacting anyone first.
<!-- /cms:pricing -->

## Practices

- Build. It does not exist yet. From a marketing site to the first version
  of a product, delivered with the repository, the pipeline and the
  documentation.
- Improve. It works, but it costs the team time. Deploys, manual processes,
  monitoring, onboarding. Ranked by hours saved per month.
- Review. It is live and there is reason to worry. External exposure,
  secrets and access, application security, interface and usability.
  Findings ranked by business impact, each with the fix written out.

## Services and prices

<!-- cms:services -->
Build
- Marketing site, 1 to 3 days, 400 to 1500 euro
- API backend, 5 to 12 days, 1800 to 6500 euro
- Web application, 12 to 25 days, 4200 to 13500 euro
- Product, first version, 30 to 55 days, 10500 to 30000 euro
- Integration or migration, 3 to 12 days, 1000 to 6500 euro

Improve
- Engineering workflow audit, 2 to 4 days, 700 to 2200 euro
- Automate a manual process, 2 to 8 days, 700 to 4400 euro
- Deploy pipeline, 3 to 8 days, 1000 to 4400 euro
- Monitoring and alerting, 3 to 7 days, 1000 to 3800 euro
- Onboarding and documentation, 3 to 6 days, 1000 to 3300 euro

Review
- Incident cleanup, 1 to 2 days, 400 to 1100 euro
- External exposure assessment, 2 to 3 days, 700 to 1650 euro
- Secrets and access review, 3 to 7 days, 1000 to 3800 euro
- Application security review, 5 to 10 days, 1750 to 5500 euro
- Interface and usability review, 3 to 7 days, 1000 to 3800 euro
<!-- /cms:services -->

Retainer: booked days inside the team, priced separately, for work that is
continuous and where a fixed scope would get in the way.

## Background

Platform security at Uber. Previously TU Delft, It Goes Forward, and Vera
Connect. Security work includes signed authorization before anything is
tested.
